summary: Informational card for a proposal submitted to a call for papers.
whenToUse: Showing the summary, author, and status of a proposal.
whenNotToUse: Editing, submitting, or assigning a submission without consumer-provided callbacks.

props.name: action
props.description: Controls provided and managed by the consumer.

keyboard.action: Reaches the title link and the controls provided in the action slot.

accessibility: The title labels the article; status, metadata, and actions are not made interactive automatically.
responsive: Metadata and header wrap when space is limited.
customization: Uses --dc-* tokens and className on the container.
commonMistakes: Do not use the card for the review workflow: controls remain the app's responsibility.
limits: No built-in persistence or CFP workflow.
